description: Extension category on MPSImage class adding utility methods for size retrieval, temporary image identification, read counting, and recycling operations.

classes.name: MPSImage (Tensor)
classes.description: Objective-C category on MPSImage adding tensor-related utility methods.

methods.name: sizes
methods.description: Returns the dimensions (N, C, H, W) of the image as a vector of int64_t.

methods.name: isTemporaryImage
methods.description: Checks if the image is a temporary image.

methods.name: markRead
methods.description: Decreases the read count of a temporary image if it is a temporary image.

methods.name: recycle
methods.description: Resets the read count of a temporary image to zero.

methods.name: readCount
methods.description: Returns the read count of a temporary image; -1 if not a temporary image.
